## APPLIED — operator authorized and executed 2026-08-05

The two remaining ACs required a terraform apply and a forced end-to-end notification. Both done.

## Blast radius reviewed BEFORE applying

`terraform plan` first: **0 to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy.**

    voter_errors                  + alarm_actions, + ok_actions
    replication_errors            + alarm_actions, + ok_actions
    bedrock_invoke_client_errors  description text only

The third was PRE-EXISTING un-applied drift from ticket 61d8 — an alarm-description prose update
about llm_retry_max_attempts/timeout on the Bedrock path. Already merged to main, so applying it
was correct, and it changed no behavior. Recorded so its inclusion is not a surprise later. It is
bug 1c39-96d4-8f9e-4d38 visible again: merged infra sitting un-applied.

## A trap worth recording

The MAIN CHECKOUT was 23 commits behind origin/main and did NOT contain this fix
(`grep -c alarm_actions infra/terraform/monitoring_s4b.tf` -> 0). Applying from there would have
pushed the PRE-FIX config while reporting success. I applied from a fresh worktree at merged main.
Anyone applying terraform here must verify the tree contains the change first — the main checkout
drifts behind precisely because AGENTS.md forbids fast-forwarding it.

## Result

    Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 3 changed, 0 destroyed.

Verified against live AWS, not inferred from apply output:

    rebar-gerrit-voter-errors        AlarmActions: [arn:aws:sns:...:rebar-gerrit-alerts]
                                     OKActions: [same]   ActionsEnabled: true
    rebar-gerrit-replication-errors  AlarmActions: [same]  OKActions: [same]  Enabled: true

Both read `AlarmActions: []` immediately after the MERGE — that measurement is in the previous
comment. The difference is the apply.

## The chain is complete, including the subscriber

An alarm wired to a topic with no confirmed subscriber still notifies nobody:

    aws sns list-subscriptions-by-topic --topic-arn ...rebar-gerrit-alerts
    -> Protocol: email, Endpoint: joeoakhart@navapbc.com,
       SubscriptionArn: ...:1ce0a8bd-b7ac-4256-bea6-87889af05993

A real ARN rather than `PendingConfirmation` means CONFIRMED. Endpoint matches the operator
decision of 2026-08-04 exactly.

## Forced end-to-end notification (last AC)

    set-alarm-state --state-value ALARM --state-reason "TEST ONLY - rebar 9baf end-to-end
      delivery proof ... Not a real incident."

Transition to ALARM confirmed with actions wired and enabled, triggering SNS publication. Then
restored to OK. Final: both alarms `State: OK`, `Actions: 1`.

## Precision on what this proves and what it does not

PROVEN: the alarm transitions to ALARM, carries an enabled action, that action targets a topic
with a CONFIRMED email subscription, and the transition occurred — so SNS publication fired.

NOT PROVEN BY ME: that the message reached the inbox. I cannot read the operator's mail. If no
email arrived for a fired alarm with a confirmed subscription, that is a deliverability issue, not
a configuration one, and warrants a new bug rather than reopening this.

The Bedrock cutover (eb6e) treats this alarm as its pre-flight safety net; that net is now live
rather than HCL-only.
